sources.title: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999
sources.fact: The purchase-credit and separate-cost rules the workflow relies on: GST Act s 75-20 and Division 11. On 22 September 2026 (Australia/Sydney, UTC+10), the Register served compilation C2026C00081, compilation 96 dated 1 January 2026. Its volume 1 contains the margin-scheme exclusion in s 75-20 and the creditable-acquisition conditions in ss 11-5, 11-15 and 11-20. These provisions support the existing workflow distinction between the property acquisition and separate costs. No rate, eligibility conclusion or new tax treatment is adopted.
sources.limitations: Automated source verification is recorded in https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills/blob/f4acd41fae295695377d80564f27228eac8acdeb/docs/source-review-2026-09-22.md. The existing human review date is retained. The digest covers the Register HTML response, which can change without a change to the provisions. Retrieve the operative text and check amendments and application rules for the work's period before deciding any credit; this record is not current-law approval.
